core_idea_en: Region descriptions, objects, attributes and relationships annotated as separate layers by separate crowd workers, with no requirement that the layers agree.

core_idea_en: A predictor that reads no pixels: given the subject and object classes it emits the most frequent predicate for that pair. Published inside the Neural Motifs paper.
core_idea_zh: 完全不讀取像素的預測器：給定主體與客體類別，輸出該配對上最常見的 predicate。發表於 Neural Motifs 論文之內。
defect_fixed_en: Not a fix but a demonstration: it beat the learned models of its era on R@K, which is what mean recall was introduced a year later to expose.
defect_fixed_zh: 此非修正而係展示：其於 R@K 上勝過同期學習式模型，而 mean recall 於一年後提出，正是為了揭露此一現象。

core_idea_en: Object labels alone predict relations remarkably well, so context flows through an LSTM over a fixed object ordering with an explicit frequency bias added.
core_idea_zh: 僅憑物件標籤即可相當準確地預測關係，故脈絡經由固定物件排序上的 LSTM 流動，並加上顯式頻率偏置。
defect_fixed_en: Free message passing contracts every belief toward the graph mean; a fixed ordering plus an explicit prior keeps the context without the contraction.
defect_fixed_zh: 自由的訊息傳遞使全部信念收縮至圖的平均值；固定排序加上顯式先驗可保留脈絡而避免該收縮。

core_idea_zh: 為問答任務重新標註 Visual Genome，清理重複的定位並大幅提高 predicate 密度。

defect_fixed_zh: Visual Genome 中重複的物件定位產生無任何貢獻的孤立節點，並使據以學習的模型產生混淆。

core_idea_en: Knowledge-embedded routing: message passing routed by statistical correlation between object pairs and predicates. Introduced mean recall, independently of VCTree.

defect_fixed_en: R@K cannot distinguish a model that understands relations from one that memorised the head of the distribution.
defect_fixed_zh: R@K 無法區分理解關係的模型與背下分布頭部的模型。

core_idea_en: A learned dynamic tree per image, so context flows along a structure chosen from the scene rather than a chain chosen by the implementer. Also introduced mean recall.
core_idea_zh: 為每張影像學習一棵動態樹，使脈絡沿著自場景選定的結構流動，而非沿實作者選定的鏈狀結構。亦為 mean recall 的提出者之一。
defect_fixed_en: A fixed object ordering is an arbitrary choice that determines what context each object can see.
defect_fixed_zh: 固定的物件排序為任意選擇，卻決定了各物件所能見到的脈絡。

defect_fixed_zh: 無方向性的平均運算摧毀承載關係語意的不對稱性，且視每一鄰居為同等可靠。

core_idea_en: Total Direct Effect: subtract a counterfactual at inference so the frequency prior's contribution is removed without retraining. Its Table 1 is the FREQ comparison.
core_idea_zh: Total Direct Effect：於推論階段扣除反事實項，使頻率先驗的貢獻在不重新訓練的前提下被移除。其 Table 1 即為 FREQ 的比較表。
defect_fixed_en: The frequency bias that makes Neural Motifs work is also what caps its mean recall; TDE removes the bias at inference rather than at training.
defect_fixed_zh: 使 Neural Motifs 有效的頻率偏置，同時也限制其 mean recall；TDE 於推論階段而非訓練階段移除該偏置。

core_idea_en: Bipartite graph message passing with confidence-aware routing and a resampling strategy aimed at the tail.
core_idea_zh: 具信心感知路由的二分圖訊息傳遞，並搭配針對長尾的重新取樣策略。
defect_fixed_en: Routing by class statistics alone still lets a noisy message from a low-confidence neighbour propagate unchecked.
defect_fixed_zh: 僅依類別統計進行路由，仍使低信心鄰居的雜訊訊息得以不受檢驗地傳播。

core_idea_en: A cognitive tree over predicates, with a loss that penalises confusion between coarse branches more than confusion within one.
core_idea_zh: 於 predicate 之上建立認知樹，其損失對粗分支之間的混淆施以較高懲罰，對同一分支內的混淆則較輕。
defect_fixed_en: Subtracting a counterfactual at inference leaves the training signal as biased as it was.
defect_fixed_zh: 於推論階段扣除反事實項，訓練訊號的偏差程度並未改變。

core_idea_en: Dynamic label frequency estimation: treat the observed predicate distribution as a biased estimate of the true one and correct the loss against it.
core_idea_zh: 動態標籤頻率估計：將觀測到的 predicate 分布視為真實分布的偏誤估計，並據以修正損失。
defect_fixed_en: A fixed hierarchy over predicates is another hand-built prior, and the annotation's own frequency drift is not modelled.
defect_fixed_zh: 於 predicate 之上的固定階層為另一項人工建構的先驗，且標註自身的頻率漂移未被建模。

core_idea_en: Relation affinity fields: a dense per-pixel vector field instead of discrete pairs. The fastest entry in the literature and the least accurate.
core_idea_zh: 關係親和場：以稠密的逐像素向量場取代離散配對。為文獻中速度最快、準確度最低者。
defect_fixed_en: Enumerating pairs costs O(N² |P|) decisions for O(N) true relations, a positive rate near one in a hundred thousand.
defect_fixed_zh: 配對列舉須付出 O(N² |P|) 次判定以換取 O(N) 個真實關係，正例率約為十萬分之一。

core_idea_en: A spatial encoder over each frame and a temporal decoder across them. The field's video baseline.
core_idea_zh: 於每一影格上執行空間編碼器，再跨影格執行時間解碼器。為該領域的影片基線。
defect_fixed_en: Running an image model once per frame cannot express that an edge persisted, so it cannot tell a real event from detector noise.
defect_fixed_zh: 逐影格執行影像模型，無法表達「某條邊持續存在」，因而無法區分真實事件與偵測器雜訊。
caveat_en: Its constrained-to-unconstrained gap is quoted in M4 as a claim marked unverified: the source note this course inherited does not name the table.
caveat_zh: 其約束與無約束模式之間的落差於 M4 以標記為未查證的 claim 引用：本課程所承接的出處註記並未指明表格編號。

core_idea_en: Builds a spatial hierarchy in real time as the robot moves: voxels to objects to places to rooms to floors, each level a lossy collapse of the one below.
core_idea_zh: 於機器人移動的同時即時建構空間階層：體素至物件、至地點、至房間、至樓層，每一層均為其下一層的有損折疊。
defect_fixed_en: A flat graph over a whole building is millions of nodes, which no planner and no language model can hold.
defect_fixed_zh: 涵蓋整棟建築的扁平圖含數百萬節點，任何規劃器與語言模型均無法容納。

core_idea_en: Internal and external data transfer: move supervision from head predicates to the tail at the data level, before any loss is computed.
core_idea_zh: 內部與外部資料遷移：於資料層級將監督訊號自頭部 predicate 移轉至長尾，先於任何損失計算。
defect_fixed_en: Relabelling fixes wrong labels but does not create supervision where the annotator recorded nothing at all.
defect_fixed_zh: 重新標記可修正錯誤標籤，但無法於標註者完全未記錄之處創造監督訊號。

core_idea_en: Says the labels are wrong: detect noisy annotations, then relabel rather than reweight.
core_idea_zh: 主張標註本身即為錯誤：先偵測有雜訊的標註，再予以重新標記而非重新加權。
defect_fixed_en: Reweighting a loss cannot repair an annotation that names the wrong predicate.
defect_fixed_zh: 重新加權損失，無法修復指認了錯誤 predicate 的標註。

core_idea_en: Re-annotates COCO with panoptic segments rather than boxes: 80 thing and 53 stuff classes indexed as one list of 133, with 56 predicates.
core_idea_zh: 以全景 segment 而非框重新標註 COCO：80 個 thing 與 53 個 stuff 類別串接為長度 133 的單一清單，並含 56 個 predicate。

core_idea_en: The dataset's two-decoder baseline: objects and relations decoded separately, then matched.
core_idea_zh: 該資料集的雙解碼器基線：物件與關係分別解碼，其後再行配對。
defect_fixed_en: A single decoder must resolve object identity and relation identity at once, which couples two errors that have different causes.
defect_fixed_zh: 單一解碼器須同時解析物件身分與關係身分，因而耦合了兩項成因不同的錯誤。

core_idea_en: The PSG dataset's one-stage transformer baseline, emitting segments rather than boxes.
core_idea_zh: PSG 資料集的單階段 transformer 基線，輸出 segment 而非框。
defect_fixed_en: Box-based methods cannot represent stuff as an object, so relations involving sky, road or wall are outside their vocabulary entirely.
defect_fixed_zh: 以框為基礎的方法無法將 stuff 表示為物件，故涉及天空、道路或牆面的關係完全在其詞彙之外。
caveat_en: Its reported mean recall was measured under the unconstrained mask pairing the 2024 correction closed. See M8.
caveat_zh: 其所報告的 mean recall 係於 2024 年修正所封閉的無約束遮罩配對之下量測。參見 M8。

core_idea_en: Builds a bipartite graph between entity proposals and predicate proposals, so the pairing is learned rather than enumerated or assumed.
core_idea_zh: 於實體提案與 predicate 提案之間建構二分圖，使配對由學習而得，而非經由列舉或假定。
defect_fixed_en: Coupling subject and object in one query fixes the pairing at query design time, before the image is seen.
defect_fixed_zh: 將主體與客體耦合於單一 query，等於在見到影像之前、於 query 設計階段即固定了配對。

core_idea_en: Builds the hierarchy with an open vocabulary from 2D foundation models rather than from a closed 3D class list.
core_idea_zh: 以 2D 基礎模型的開放詞彙建構該階層，而非依據封閉的 3D 類別清單。
defect_fixed_en: A closed 3D class list cannot name the objects a household task actually refers to, and 3D annotation is far scarcer than 2D.
defect_fixed_zh: 封閉的 3D 類別清單無法指認家務任務實際指涉的物件，且 3D 標註遠較 2D 稀少。

core_idea_en: The second backbone IndVisSGG evaluates inside its multi-agent strategy. A proprietary model at a version that is no longer reproducible.
core_idea_zh: IndVisSGG 於其多代理策略中所評估的第二個骨幹模型。為專有模型，且其所測試的版本已無法重現。
defect_fixed_en: Not a fix: a second backbone, reported without attribution, in an uncontrolled comparison of two proprietary models at two moments in time.
defect_fixed_zh: 此非修正：為第二個骨幹模型，於兩個專有模型、兩個時間點的非受控比較中被報告，且未附任何歸因。
caveat_en: No figure is carried here. IndVisSGG's Table 2 reports ISG numbers for “IndVisSGG-Gemini”, which is IndVisSGG running on this model; those numbers describe that method and are carried on its card.
caveat_zh: 本卡不載任何數值。IndVisSGG 的 Table 2 所報告之 ISG 數值屬於「IndVisSGG-Gemini」，即 IndVisSGG 搭配本模型之結果；該組數值描述的是該方法，故載於該方法之卡片。

core_idea_en: High- and low-frequency branches run separately and merged, on the observation that predicate frequency and predicate specificity pull in opposite directions.
core_idea_zh: 高頻與低頻分支分別執行其後合併；其觀察在於 predicate 的頻率與特異性方向相反。
defect_fixed_en: One branch trained on the whole distribution learns the head and abandons the tail, whatever reweighting is applied.
defect_fixed_zh: 於完整分布上訓練的單一分支將學會頭部而捨棄長尾，無論施加何種重新加權。
caveat_en: Its reported mean recall was measured under the pairing the 2024 correction closed, and it is the method the correction hit hardest.
caveat_zh: 其所報告的 mean recall 係於 2024 年修正所封閉的配對規則之下量測，且為受該修正衝擊最大的方法。

core_idea_en: Measures where the loss actually is and finds that pair recall, not relation classification, is the binding constraint.
core_idea_zh: 量測損失實際發生之處，並發現具拘束力的限制條件為 pair recall，而非關係分類。
defect_fixed_en: Improving the relation classifier cannot recover ground truth whose subject-object pair was never proposed.
defect_fixed_zh: 改進關係分類器，無法找回其主客體配對從未被提出的標準答案。

core_idea_en: Prototype embedding: learn a prototype per predicate and match against it, so a rare predicate is represented by its centre rather than by its frequency.
core_idea_zh: 原型嵌入：為每一 predicate 學習一個原型並與之比對，使稀有 predicate 由其中心而非其頻率所表示。
defect_fixed_en: Discriminative heads allocate capacity in proportion to class frequency, whatever the loss weighting does afterwards.
defect_fixed_zh: 判別式分類頭依類別頻率比例分配容量，無論其後的損失加權為何。

core_idea_en: Coupled subject and object queries, so one query carries both ends of a triplet through a DETR-style decoder.
core_idea_zh: 耦合的主體與客體 query，使單一 query 經由 DETR 式解碼器同時承載三元組的兩端。
defect_fixed_en: A dense affinity field cannot represent two relations between the same pair, and its accuracy sits far below the two-stage line.
defect_fixed_zh: 稠密親和場無法表示同一配對之間的兩種關係，且其準確度遠低於兩階段方法的水準。

core_idea_en: Searches over a collapsed graph and expands only the branch it needs, which is the direct answer to the language model's token bound.
core_idea_zh: 於折疊後的圖上搜尋，僅展開所需分支；此為對語言模型 token 界限的直接回答。
defect_fixed_en: At roughly seven tokens per node the level a language model can hold is fixed by its context window, not by what the robot perceives.
defect_fixed_zh: 以每節點約七個 token 計，語言模型所能容納的層級由其脈絡窗口決定，而非由機器人所感知者決定。

core_idea_en: Memory-guided training with explicit uncertainty: models how confident it should be, not only what it believes.
core_idea_zh: 以記憶引導訓練並顯式建模不確定性：所建模者不僅為「相信什麼」，亦包含「應當多有把握」。
defect_fixed_en: A temporal decoder with no memory of earlier scenes and no confidence estimate cannot distinguish a stable relation from a lucky frame.
defect_fixed_zh: 不具先前場景記憶、亦無信心估計的時間解碼器，無法區分穩定關係與僥倖的單一影格。

core_idea_en: Inherits a visual-semantic space from a grounding model, so an unseen object name arrives already aligned to image features.
core_idea_zh: 自 grounding 模型繼承視覺語意空間，使未見過的物件名稱抵達時即已與影像特徵對齊。
defect_fixed_en: A closed class list cannot name anything outside it, and the vocabulary was always whatever the annotators happened to write.
defect_fixed_zh: 封閉的類別清單無法指認清單以外的任何事物，而該詞彙始終僅為標註者當時所書寫的內容。

core_idea_en: Verification over generation: ask the model to check a candidate rather than to produce one, because the narrower question is answered more reliably.
core_idea_zh: 以驗證取代生成：要求模型檢查候選而非產生候選，因較狹窄的問題可獲得更可靠的回答。
defect_fixed_en: A model asked to generate a graph hallucinates plausible relations, and the frequency prior makes the plausible ones the common ones.
defect_fixed_zh: 受要求生成圖的模型會產生合理但不存在的關係，而頻率先驗使「合理者」恰為「常見者」。

core_idea_en: Task-driven granularity: the collapse is lossy with respect to the task, because granularity is a property of the scene and the job to be done.
core_idea_zh: 任務驅動的粒度：折疊之有損性係相對於任務而言，因粒度為場景與所欲完成工作兩者共同的性質。
defect_fixed_en: A graph built without knowing the query guesses which distinctions matter, and guesses wrong in both directions.
defect_fixed_zh: 在不知查詢內容下建構的圖，須猜測何種區辨具有意義，且於兩個方向上同時猜錯。

core_idea_en: Treats the whole problem as a single graph-prediction task rather than as detection followed by relation assignment.
core_idea_zh: 將整體問題視為單一的圖預測任務，而非偵測之後再進行關係指派。
defect_fixed_en: Splitting entity and predicate proposals into two sets reintroduces an assignment step that the set-prediction framing was meant to remove.
defect_fixed_zh: 將實體提案與 predicate 提案分為兩組，等於重新引入集合預測框架原欲移除的指派步驟。

core_idea_en: Extracts relations from the detector's own decoder self-attention, on the observation that a detector already computes object-to-object interaction and then discards it.
core_idea_zh: 自偵測器本身解碼器的自注意力中萃取關係；其觀察在於偵測器原已計算物件間交互作用，其後卻予以捨棄。
defect_fixed_en: A separate relation head recomputes interaction the detector has already computed, at the cost of a second set of parameters.
defect_fixed_zh: 獨立的關係分類頭重新計算偵測器已計算過的交互作用，代價為第二組參數。

core_idea_en: Combines a holistic image description with region captions so the model reasons about the whole scene and the parts, then reconciles the two.
core_idea_zh: 將整體影像描述與區域圖說結合，使模型同時就整體場景與各部分進行推理，其後予以調和。
defect_fixed_en: A caption describes the scene from one viewpoint and omits relations between parts it did not mention.
defect_fixed_zh: 圖說自單一視角描述場景，並省略其未提及之各部分之間的關係。

core_idea_en: Ships explicit negatives — relations annotated as not holding — which is the only dataset in this course that makes precision computable.
core_idea_zh: 提供顯式負例——被標註為不成立的關係——為本課程中唯一使精確率可計算的資料集。
defect_fixed_en: Precision needs to know what is false, and no other dataset records it, which is why the field reports recall alone.
defect_fixed_zh: 精確率需要知道何者為偽，而其他資料集均未記錄此一資訊；此即該領域僅報告 recall 的理由。

core_idea_en: Hybrid one-to-many assignment, so a single prediction may be matched against several ground-truth triplets during training.
core_idea_zh: 一對多的混合指派，使單一預測於訓練期間可與多個標準答案三元組進行配對。
defect_fixed_en: Specialising queries by group still gives each ground-truth triplet exactly one supervisory signal, which starves the tail.
defect_fixed_zh: 依組別專門化 query，仍使每一標準答案三元組僅獲得單一監督訊號，長尾因而訓練不足。

core_idea_en: Merges Visual Genome classes into a smaller indoor vocabulary, which raises mean recall arithmetically and makes its figures incomparable with VG150's.
core_idea_zh: 將 Visual Genome 的類別合併為較小的室內詞彙；此一操作於算術上提高 mean recall，並使其數值與 VG150 不可比較。
defect_fixed_en: Not a fix: a merge, and M1 gives the arithmetic of what a merge does to mean recall with the model unchanged.
defect_fixed_zh: 此非修正：為一項合併操作，而 M1 已給出「模型不變之下合併對 mean recall 之影響」的算術。

core_idea_en: A language model extracts triplets from image captions and aligns them to the target vocabulary, producing supervision for images that had none. Names the failure mode semantic over-simplification.
core_idea_zh: 以語言模型自圖說中萃取三元組並對齊至目標詞彙，為原本無標註的影像產生監督訊號。並將該失效模式命名為 semantic over-simplification。
defect_fixed_en: Data-level transfer can only move supervision that exists; a caption carries relations the relationship layer never recorded.
defect_fixed_zh: 資料層級的遷移僅能移轉既有的監督訊號；而圖說承載了關係層從未記錄的關係。

core_idea_en: One-stage and tracker-free: removes the separate association step, which was a large fraction of both the error and the engineering.
core_idea_zh: 單階段且不使用追蹤器：移除獨立的關聯步驟，而該步驟原佔誤差與工程成本之相當比例。
defect_fixed_en: A separate tracker introduces association errors that propagate into every relation decision downstream.
defect_fixed_zh: 獨立的追蹤器引入關聯誤差，並將該誤差傳播至其後每一項關係判定。

core_idea_en: Aligns nodes and edges separately, because an object name transfers through a pretrained text encoder and a relation does not.
core_idea_zh: 分別對齊節點與邊，因為物件名稱可經由預訓練文字編碼器遷移，而關係則否。
defect_fixed_en: Inheriting one joint space treats object and relation generalisation as the same problem, and withholding relations hurts far more than withholding objects.
defect_fixed_zh: 繼承單一聯合空間，等同將物件泛化與關係泛化視為同一問題；而保留關係所造成的損害遠大於保留物件。
caveat_en: Its split sizes and novel-split figures are stated in M9 as claims marked unverified; this project has not opened its table.
caveat_zh: 其分割規模與 novel 分割數值於 M9 以標記為未查證的 claim 陳述；本專案尚未查閱其表格。

core_idea_en: Generates novel predicate words rather than selecting from a list, framing relation prediction as sequence generation.
core_idea_zh: 生成新的 predicate 詞彙而非自清單中選取，將關係預測視為序列生成問題。
defect_fixed_en: Aligning to a fixed predicate vocabulary still cannot produce a relation the vocabulary does not contain.
defect_fixed_zh: 對齊至固定的 predicate 詞彙，仍無法產生該詞彙未收錄的關係。

core_idea_en: Shows that the original PSG protocol let a model score the same pair through several duplicate masks, which costs a one-stage architecture nothing and pays it well.
core_idea_zh: 指出原始 PSG 協定允許模型以多份重複遮罩就同一配對重複計分，此對單階段架構不構成成本且獲利可觀。
defect_fixed_en: Mask pairing was unconstrained, so duplicate masks inflated one-stage mean recall while leaving two-stage methods untouched.
defect_fixed_zh: 遮罩配對未受約束，故重複遮罩虛增單階段方法的 mean recall，而兩階段方法不受影響。
caveat_en: This project has not opened the correction's own table, so its measured effect is stated in M8 as a claim marked unverified rather than carried as a number here.
caveat_zh: 本專案尚未查閱該修正自身的表格，故其實測效果於 M8 以標記為未查證的 claim 陳述，而不在此作為數值收錄。

core_idea_en: Treats the annotation as partial rather than complete, and re-assigns an unannotated pair to a plausible predicate instead of scoring it as a negative.
core_idea_zh: 將標註視為部分標註而非完整標註，並將未標註的配對重新指派至合理的 predicate，而非計為負例。
defect_fixed_en: Self-training still treats every unannotated pair as a negative, which is the assumption the incomplete annotation makes false.
defect_fixed_zh: 自我訓練仍將每一未標註配對視為負例，而標註的不完整性正使該假設不成立。

core_idea_en: Groupwise query specialization: a query becomes responsible for a kind of relation rather than for an arbitrary slot.
core_idea_zh: 分組式 query 專門化：使單一 query 負責某一類關係，而非某一個任意位置。
defect_fixed_en: With one-to-one assignment most queries see only the no-object class in training and never become useful.
defect_fixed_zh: 於一對一指派之下，多數 query 於訓練期間僅見到無物件類別，因而始終無法發揮作用。

core_idea_en: Self-training with an adaptive per-class threshold, so pseudo-labels for rare predicates are admitted on different evidence from common ones.
core_idea_zh: 採用逐類別自適應門檻的自我訓練，使稀有 predicate 的偽標籤得以依不同於常見類別的證據標準被接受。
defect_fixed_en: A single confidence threshold over a long-tailed distribution admits head pseudo-labels and rejects tail ones, which deepens the bias it was meant to fix.
defect_fixed_zh: 於長尾分布之上採用單一信心門檻，將接受頭部偽標籤而拒絕長尾偽標籤，從而加深其原欲修正的偏差。

core_idea_en: Given a graph, predict the relations the annotator did not record — a direct assault on annotation incompleteness.
core_idea_zh: 給定一張圖，預測標註者未曾記錄的關係——對標註不完整性的直接攻堅。
defect_fixed_en: Reasoning from captions still inherits the caption's omissions; the incompleteness has to be attacked in the graph itself.
defect_fixed_zh: 自圖說推理，仍承襲圖說的疏漏；不完整性須於圖本身之上處理。

core_idea_en: Diffusion over the video scene graph, generating the temporal structure rather than decoding it frame by frame.
core_idea_zh: 於影片場景圖之上執行擴散模型，生成其時間結構，而非逐影格解碼。
defect_fixed_en: Decoding one frame at a time makes the temporal structure a by-product rather than something the model is trained to produce.
defect_fixed_zh: 逐影格解碼使時間結構成為附帶產物，而非模型受訓所欲產生的對象。

core_idea_en: Constrains a VLM's output vocabulary with object and predicate dictionaries plus worked examples, then audits the result with N further calls to the same model. The course's anchor paper.
core_idea_zh: 以物件字典、predicate 字典與範例約束 VLM 的輸出詞彙，其後再以 N 次對同一模型的呼叫審查其結果。為本課程的主軸論文。
defect_fixed_en: A frontier VLM asked plainly scores R@20 = 0.032 — not because it cannot see, but because it does not know which words are allowed.
defect_fixed_zh: 前沿 VLM 在未加約束下的 R@20 為 0.032——並非因其無法看見，而是因其不知何種詞彙獲准使用。

core_idea_en: The efficiency entry: pushes the speed-accuracy frontier left without giving up the set-prediction framing.
core_idea_zh: 效率取向的成果：在不放棄集合預測框架的前提下，將速度與準確度前緣向左推進。
defect_fixed_en: One-to-many assignment raises accuracy at a cost in training time and in the cubic Hungarian step.
defect_fixed_zh: 一對多指派提升準確度，代價為訓練時間與立方複雜度的 Hungarian 步驟。

core_idea_en: Relation verification with in-context evidence, extending the verification framing to the tail.
core_idea_zh: 以脈絡內證據進行關係驗證，將驗證框架延伸至長尾。
defect_fixed_en: Verification with no evidence beyond the image still falls back on the prior for rare relations.
defect_fixed_zh: 除影像之外別無證據的驗證，於稀有關係上仍將退回依賴先驗。

core_idea_en: Relation completion with a multimodal model, scored against held-out edges rather than against the incomplete annotation as a whole.
core_idea_zh: 以多模態模型進行關係補全，並以保留的邊而非整體不完整標註作為評分依據。
defect_fixed_en: Scoring a completion against the same incomplete annotation it is trying to complete cannot measure whether it worked.
defect_fixed_zh: 以同一份不完整標註評分其自身的補全結果，無法量測該補全是否有效。

core_idea_en: The graph as reasoning substrate: the intermediate representation a downstream question is answered over, not the deliverable.
core_idea_zh: 以圖作為推理基底：其為下游問題據以作答的中間表示，而非最終交付物。
defect_fixed_en: Producing a graph and scoring it against an annotation measures transcription, not whether the graph supports the reasoning it was built for.
defect_fixed_zh: 產生一張圖並以標註加以評分，所量測者為轉錄品質，而非該圖是否支撐其建構目的所在的推理。

core_idea_en: Reinforcement learning against a reward computed from graph structure rather than from token likelihood.
core_idea_zh: 以自圖結構計算而得的獎勵訊號、而非以 token 似然度進行強化學習。
defect_fixed_en: Training on token likelihood optimises the wording of the output, and the metric scores the structure.
defect_fixed_zh: 以 token 似然度訓練所最佳化者為輸出的用詞，而指標所評分者為結構。

core_idea_en: Unified online prediction: one model producing the graph as the video arrives, without seeing future frames.
core_idea_zh: 統一的線上預測：單一模型於影片抵達的同時產生圖，且不參照未來影格。
defect_fixed_en: A model that reads the whole clip cannot be deployed on a live stream, which is where every stated application of video scene graphs sits.
defect_fixed_zh: 須讀取整段影片的模型無法部署於即時串流，而影片場景圖所宣稱的全部應用皆位於此。

core_idea_en: Extends the hierarchy with a vision-language model at each level, so the collapse itself is open-vocabulary.
core_idea_zh: 於各層級以視覺語言模型擴充該階層，使折疊本身亦具開放詞彙性質。
defect_fixed_en: Task-driven granularity still needs a fixed procedure for deciding what a level contains; a model at each level decides it from the scene.
defect_fixed_zh: 任務驅動的粒度仍需固定程序以決定各層所含內容；於各層設置模型，則使該決定得以自場景導出。

core_idea_en: Reported as raising recall and mean recall together, which would be the first time the debiasing trade-off stopped binding.
core_idea_zh: 據報告可同時提升 recall 與 mean recall；若屬實，此為去偏權衡首次不再構成拘束。
defect_fixed_en: Every method from TDE onward bought mean recall with recall; this is claimed not to.
defect_fixed_zh: 自 TDE 以降的每一方法，均以 recall 換取 mean recall；本方法宣稱並非如此。
caveat_en: This project has not opened this paper's table. M6 carries its figures as a claim marked unverified, and no number is carried here.
caveat_zh: 本專案尚未查閱該論文的表格。M6 以標記為未查證的 claim 收錄其數值，此處不收錄任何數值。
